description.p: Certyneo Reader opens any PDF with a double-click, even offline, and goes beyond a viewer. Documents stay on your computer: opening, reading, annotating or editing a PDF never uploads the file.

ul.li: Comfortable reading: full-text search, thumbnails, zoom, rotation, night mode, password-protected files and printing
Annotation, form filling, and turning a print-only document into a fillable form
Assisted redaction, watermarks and Bates numbering
Text and table extraction
Batch processing: compress, protect or finalise several files at once
A word processor with styles, lists, tables, pictures, headers and page numbers, that opens and saves Word (.docx) files and exports PDFs

description.p: Documents you create stay free to edit, even as PDF. Editing the text of other PDFs requires an optional annual licence; everything else is free, with no account and no ads.

screenshot.caption: Reading a PDF with page thumbnails
PDF tools: annotate, redact, fill in forms, extract

ul.li: Measure on the page: distance, perimeter, area and angle, at the scale of the drawing; the pointer snaps to the corners of the drawing (Ctrl+Shift+M).
Set the scale from a known dimension; measurements can be written into the document or exported as a table (CSV).
Read aloud: the computer’s voice reads the document, highlights the word being read and can start from where you click (Ctrl+Shift+L).
Comment list: every annotation in the document, page by page, with search and export as a table.
Search for text in every PDF of a folder, then open the result at the right page.
Print several pages per sheet, as a booklet or as a poster; compare two versions side by side.
Narrow window: the top bar stays on one line with a mouse. Touch screen: larger handles. Forms tab: “Online form”.
Fixes: “Clipboard to PDF” in the app; a PDF followed by stray data no longer freezes Protect, Split or batch processing.
More room for the document: a compact one-line ribbon, or a collapsed one that keeps only the tabs (Reader options, or double-click a tab).
Quick access at the top left: Undo, Redo (new, Ctrl+Y), Open, Save, Print.
Right-click on the document: zoom, rotate, pages, search, and Copy or Search the selected text.
PDF links are clickable; Back and Forward between the pages you viewed (Alt+← / Alt+→).
Finer search (match case, whole word, accents), print one page or a range, move pages by dragging thumbnails.
Recent PDFs on the home screen, and the window reopens at its size and position.
New tabbed ribbon, like Acrobat: View, Create, Convert, Edit, Page, Insert, Review, Forms, Secure and sign, OCR.
Several documents in tabs, a home screen and a more colourful look, with a tooltip on every button.
Scan from a scanner (Windows, network, Linux), straighten a scan with OCR, create a PDF from the clipboard or a web page.
Insert, cut and paste an image; shapes, links, attachments and background.
Forms and certificate signing: complete tools, with a self-signed certificate created in the app.
Opens more formats (.cbz, .xls, .wwf…); changing the language applies at once, without losing your tabs.
Word (.docx) import: documents with many images no longer exhaust memory.
If the display crashes repeatedly, the app switches to software rendering and stays usable.
More reliable start-up: several rare crashes when opening or cleaning temporary files are fixed.
Damaged PDFs: reading now fails cleanly instead of freezing the app.
New tools menu in five sections, with two licence plans: Standard and Pro.
New tools: clean the document, accessibility check, headers and footers, stamp, edit images, sign with a certificate.
Add text: choose the font, bold and italic.
Damaged or booby-trapped PDFs: repaired or refused with a clear message, without freezing the app.
Reliable keyboard shortcuts (AZERTY, QWERTZ, Dvorak, AltGr, input methods); Save and Print no longer run twice.
Word processor: case change fixed, deleting a column keeps your draft, more reliable Word import and export.
Redaction: choose the colour of the covered areas (black, grey, white or any shade), for example for a lighter print.
The covered text is still removed from the file, whatever the colour.
Certyneo printer: uninstalling removes the working copies before quitting; a reinstall waits for the clean-up to finish.
Damaged PDFs or files cut off during a download are refused instead of being saved incomplete.
A page with no declared size opens as Letter, like elsewhere, and can be cropped, numbered or rotated.
Protected PDFs: opening also works when the password has accented letters typed another way.
Text recognition: very large images are capped to avoid freezing the app.
Certyneo Reader comes to the Mac: a universal app for Intel and Apple Silicon Macs, signed and notarized by Apple.
On Windows and Linux, this version is the same as 1.5.4.
Word export: your comments are saved in the .docx file, with the commented passage and their resolved state.
Opening a Word document: its comments come back in the Comments pane.
Arabic and Persian: the word processor ruler starts from the right, as in Word.
Word processor: in Page view, text no longer runs into the bottom margin or between two sheets after a paste; the PDF has the same pages as the screen.
A blank Word document opens ready to write: the cursor is in the page and Ctrl+V pastes right away, without a licence.
Pasting from Word: bookmarks, contents tables and comments no longer leave fake blue links or stray notes in the document.
In the PDF, tabs, runs of spaces and table column widths are the same as on screen.
No more extra empty sheet when a document ends with a signature field or an image at the very bottom of a page.
The status bar page number is right when the cursor is in an empty paragraph.
Arabic and Persian: the app is displayed right to left — toolbar, menus, ribbon and dialogs.
Word processor: Arabic text starts on the right and tables begin on the right; an English paragraph stays on the left.
PDF and Word exports keep the right-to-left direction of your documents.
Word processor: pasting text copied from the web or an email no longer freezes the window; pasting from Word keeps its lists.
Typing after clicking an image or a signature field writes in the right place; Ctrl+Shift+V pastes without formatting.
Comments and tracked changes are no longer attached to a PDF you export or send for signature; you are warned about pending changes.
An edited PDF is no longer lost without asking when you open another file, close it or change the language.
The PDF tools menu scrolls: Watermark, Number pages, Bates, Convert and Batch processing are reachable again.
Watermarks fit and read correctly on rotated pages; Black and white and Compress keep the text of those pages; merging keeps form fields.
More than 30 other fixes from a full test pass of the app.
Convert to PDF: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, RTF, images, HEIC photos, TIFF, PSD and Illustrator, on your computer.
Drop any of these files into the window: it opens straight away as a PDF.
Crop: trim margins to the millimetre or detect white margins automatically, or switch to A4, A3, A5, Letter or Legal.
Number pages: “3”, “3 / 12” or “Page 3 of 12”, wherever you want, with or without the cover page.
Insert blank pages or the pages of another file; delete, rotate or extract pages by their numbers.
PDF to PowerPoint: one slide per page, as a faithful picture or as editable text.
Image to PDF now also accepts multi-page TIFF, HEIC photos, SVG and PSD.
Hover over a button: a tooltip explains what it does and shows its keyboard shortcut.
New Help panel (? button or F1): every feature explained, with a search box and the list of shortcuts.
A short guided tour shows the essentials the first time you open a document.
Certyneo Reader Pro: the same license now also unlocks OCR in 48 languages, conversion to Word and Excel, and PDF/A.
OCR in 48 languages, including Russian and Chinese: recognized text stays selectable and copyable. French and English remain free.
Convert a PDF to Word (headings, tables, bold and italics) or to Excel (one sheet per page, amounts written as numbers).
PDF/A-2b for legal archiving: if a document cannot be made compliant, the conversion says so instead of producing a fake PDF/A.
Team license: 5 or 10 seats with a single key and a single invoice.
Installed from Flathub, “About” now says that updates come through Flathub, via your software center or “flatpak update”.
Certyneo Reader comes to Flathub: on Linux, install it and get its updates from your software center.
Inside a Flatpak, updates come from Flathub and the app no longer updates itself.
Ready-to-fill templates: service agreement, quote, invoice, termination letter, power of attorney and résumé, written for your country.
Signature fields in the text and “Send for signature”: the Certyneo envelope opens with the fields already placed.
Page view with a ruler: pages are shown separately and margins can be set with the mouse.
Automatic table of contents, comments, track changes (accept or reject) and columns.
Recent documents one click away, on the start screen and under “Open…”.
Link the app to your free Certyneo account: your documents stay yours, free to edit, on all your computers.
New word processor: styles, fonts, colors, lists, tables, pictures, links, header, footer and page numbers, just like in Word.
Save it as a PDF in one click: crisp, selectable text with embedded fonts. The editable document travels inside the PDF.
Open your Word documents (.docx) and save in Word format: headings, lists, tables, pictures and page layout are kept.
A document you created stays free to edit, even once it is a PDF: reopen it in the editor, or use “Edit text” without a license.
Page setup (size, orientation, margins), page breaks, find and replace, word count, and your system’s spell checker.
Automatic recovery: an unsaved document survives an unexpected shutdown.
Fill a PDF form from the keyboard, and make it final once it is complete.
Create a fillable form from a document meant for printing: the input areas are detected, you review them.
Batch processing: compress, protect or finalise several files at once, then get everything back as one archive.
Assisted redaction: IBANs, social security numbers, emails and card numbers are proposed for masking.
Redact every occurrence of a term in the document, whatever its case or accents.
Watermark « CONFIDENTIAL », « COPY » or the recipient's name, diagonally, on one page or all of them.
Bates numbering: a unique, sequential identifier per page, for legal productions.
Extract a document's text, or its tables as a file your spreadsheet opens directly.
Retyping the existing text of a PDF now requires a Certyneo Reader licence.
Everything else is unchanged: reading, annotations, text you add, redaction, OCR, merging and conversions stay free.
The licence is bought on certyneo.com, activated with a key in the app, and covers one year on three devices.
New PDF tools: organize pages, merge, split, compress, or protect a file with a password.
Conversions: turn images into a PDF, or export every page as an image.
Annotate your documents: highlight, draw, comment and add stamps.
Edit the text of a PDF and keep its original font, including fonts installed on your computer.
Make scanned pages searchable (OCR), and redact sensitive passages: the hidden text is really removed.
Compare two versions of a document to spot the lines added and removed.
Tampering detector: the signs of an edit (a retyped amount, an invalid IBAN, hidden text) are listed and circled on the page.
Signatures panel, automatic updates, app language (French or English), and reporting a problem without leaving the app.
Open your PDFs right on your computer: they never leave it.
Search the whole document, with every match highlighted.
Print your documents without leaving the app.
Make Certyneo Reader your default PDF viewer, or use “Open with”.
Page thumbnails, night mode and support for password-protected PDFs.
Available in 55 languages on Windows, macOS and Linux.
